title: RISE and stayMellow spread positive vibes with “The Way You Make Me Feel”
htmlContent:
RISE has returned with their latest upbeat single, "The Way You Make Me Feel," and it's all about those feel good vibes. Collaborating once again with vocalist and bassist stayMellow (Sam Kinley), the band continues the exciting musical journey they started with their previous songs.

"The Way You Make Me Feel" radiates warmth and positivity. The song features RISE's signature mix of bright synth sounds, catchy guitar riffs, and lively drumming. The band, made up of Alex Mahoney on drums, Brian Petch on guitar, and Paul Kinley on synths, creates a vibrant sound. The layers of music build naturally, giving the song a big feel while keeping it intimate.

https://open.spotify.com/album/1HfVueskPw1YLUOoDOB13d?si=thLht_bEQret6GcNzvLnRQ

The song is all about celebrating connection and the uplifting power of music. RISE surprises listeners with a unique section that adds a twist, showing off their ability to mix complex ideas with a sound that's easy to enjoy. "The Way You Make Me Feel" is RISE at its best bold, uplifting, and full of rich sound. It's a track that encourages you to lose yourself in the beat.
